```{r}
# Load the CLEAR dataset and inspect its dimensions and structure
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

column_types <- rep("guess", 28)
column_types[9] <- "text"  # Lexile Band

clear_raw <- read_excel(
  "/Users/nataliakolbina/workspace/pda-course-work/CLEAR_original/CLEAR_corpus_final.xlsx",
  sheet = "Data",
  col_types = column_types,
  guess_max = 5000
)

names(clear_raw) <- make.names(names(clear_raw))

clear_raw <- clear_raw %>%
  rename(
    BT.Easiness = BT_easiness,
    BT.s.e. = s.e.
  )

dim(clear_raw)
glimpse(clear_raw)
```
```{r}
# Clean the text and target data, then inspect BT.Easiness
clear <- clear_raw %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Excerpt),
    trimws(Excerpt) != "",
    !is.na(BT.Easiness)
  )
dim(clear)
summary(clear$BT.Easiness)
sd(clear$BT.Easiness)
```
```{r}
# Visualise the distribution of the readability target
ggplot(clear, aes(x = BT.Easiness)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of BT Easiness",
    x = "BT Easiness",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```
```{r}
# Check the number and percentage of missing values in each variable
missing_values <- clear %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~sum(is.na(.))
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = Missing / nrow(clear) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Percentage))

missing_values
```
```{r}
# Select the traditional readability features available in the CLEAR dataset
readability_features <- c(
  "Flesch.Reading.Ease",
  "Flesch.Kincaid.Grade.Level",
  "Automated.Readability.Index",
  "SMOG.Readability",
  "New.Dale.Chall.Readability.Formula",
  "CAREC",
  "CAREC_M",
  "CARES",
  "CML2RI",
  "Google.WC",
  "Sentence.Count.v1",
  "Sentence.Count.v2",
  "Paragraphs"
)

available_features <- readability_features[
  readability_features %in% names(clear)
]
available_features
```
```{r}
# Visualise the distributions of the available readability features
clear %>%
  select(all_of(available_features)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Feature,
    scales = "free",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distributions of CLEAR Readability Features",
    x = "Value",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```
```{r}
# Examine how each traditional readability feature relates to BT.Easiness
cor_data <- clear %>%
  select(
    BT.Easiness,
    all_of(available_features)
  )

cor_target <- cor_data %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      -BT.Easiness,
      ~cor(
        .,
        cor_data$BT.Easiness,
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
        method = "spearman"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Correlation"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Correlation)))

cor_target
```


```{r}
# Check passage length before readability modelling
clear <- clear %>%
  mutate(
    word_length = str_count(Excerpt, "\\S+")
  )

summary(clear$word_length)

ggplot(clear, aes(x = word_length)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Excerpt Length",
    x = "Number of Words",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```
```{r}
# Examine the relationship between passage length and BT.Easiness
ggplot(
  clear,
  aes(
    x = word_length,
    y = BT.Easiness
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Text Length vs BT Easiness",
    x = "Word Count",
    y = "BT Easiness"
  )
```
```{r}
# Test the association between passage length and BT.Easiness
cor.test(
  clear$word_length,
  clear$BT.Easiness,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Examine the uncertainty in BT.Easiness ratings
summary(clear$BT.s.e.)

ggplot(clear, aes(x = BT.s.e.)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Uncertainty in BT Easiness",
    x = "BT Standard Error",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```

```{r}
# Check whether uncertainty in BT.Easiness varies with the target value
ggplot(
  clear,
  aes(
    x = BT.s.e.,
    y = BT.Easiness
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Check how many passages remain after cleaning
nrow(clear_raw)
nrow(clear)

nrow(clear_raw) - nrow(clear)
```
```{r}
# Select the variables required for readability modelling
clear_model <- clear %>%
  select(
    Excerpt,
    BT.Easiness,
    BT.s.e.,
    Flesch.Reading.Ease,
    Flesch.Kincaid.Grade.Level,
    Automated.Readability.Index,
    SMOG.Readability,
    New.Dale.Chall.Readability.Formula,
    CAREC,
    CAREC_M,
    CARES,
    CML2RI,
    Google.WC,
    Sentence.Count.v1,
    Sentence.Count.v2,
    Paragraphs
  )
```

```{r}
# Check missing values in the final modelling variables
clear_model %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~sum(is.na(.))
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing))
```

```{r}
# Check for duplicated passages before splitting the dataset
duplicates <- clear_model %>%
  count(Excerpt) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

nrow(duplicates)
```

```{r}
# Set a seed to make the dataset split reproducible
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
# Split the cleaned data into 70% training, 15% validation and 15% test sets
n <- nrow(clear_model)

train_index <- sample(
  seq_len(n),
  size = floor(0.70 * n)
)

train <- clear_model[train_index, ]

remaining <- clear_model[-train_index, ]

validation_index <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(remaining)),
  size = floor(0.50 * nrow(remaining))
)

validation <- remaining[validation_index, ]

test <- remaining[-validation_index, ]
```

```{r}
# Verify the size of each split and confirm that all passages are retained
nrow(train)
nrow(validation)
nrow(test)

nrow(train) + nrow(validation) + nrow(test)
```

```{r}
# Compare BT.Easiness summary statistics across the three dataset splits
train %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(BT.Easiness),
    sd = sd(BT.Easiness),
    min = min(BT.Easiness),
    max = max(BT.Easiness)
  )

validation %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(BT.Easiness),
    sd = sd(BT.Easiness),
    min = min(BT.Easiness),
    max = max(BT.Easiness)
  )

test %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(BT.Easiness),
    sd = sd(BT.Easiness),
    min = min(BT.Easiness),
    max = max(BT.Easiness)
  )
```

```{r}
# Compare BT.Easiness distributions across the dataset splits
bind_rows(
  train %>% mutate(Split = "Train"),
  validation %>% mutate(Split = "Validation"),
  test %>% mutate(Split = "Test")
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BT.Easiness)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~Split) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "BT Easiness Distribution Across Dataset Splits",
    x = "BT Easiness",
    y = "Density"
  )
```

```{r}
# Examine passage-length percentiles
quantile(
  clear$word_length,
  probs = c(.50, .75, .90, .95, .99),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Export the train, validation and test datasets for readability modelling
write.csv(
  train,
  "clear_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  validation,
  "clear_validation.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  test,
  "clear_test.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
